plans.idea: Faithful vertical reflow of the original: brand logo top-left, full-width copy stack sharing the left edge, bottle centred below, and the purple pill anchoring the bottom as the call to action.
Product-first story: centred logo over a large centred bottle that grabs attention, then the headline and feature list below it, closing on a centred pill button.
Message-led column: the headline and copy fill the top half, the CTA pill sits right under its copy, then the bottle, with the logo as a small centred sign-off at the foot.
